```sh
paperworks create-pdf --spec "$SKILL_DIR/examples/report.json" --output report.pdf
paperworks inspect report.pdf > report-check.json
paperworks pdf-text report.pdf --output report.txt
paperworks create-pdf --spec "$SKILL_DIR/examples/review-form.json" --output review-form.pdf
paperworks inspect review-form.pdf > before.json
cat > values.json <<'JSON'
{"reviewer":"Example reviewer"}
JSON
paperworks fill review-form.pdf --values values.json --output completed.pdf
paperworks inspect completed.pdf > after.json
paperworks render completed.pdf --output pdf-pages --max-pixels 1600
paperworks fill completed.pdf --values values.json --output flattened.pdf --flatten
paperworks inspect flattened.pdf > flat-check.json
paperworks render flattened.pdf --output flat-pages --max-pixels 1600
```

```sh
paperworks create-pdf --spec "$SKILL_DIR/examples/flow.json" --output flowing.pdf
paperworks inspect flowing.pdf > flowing-check.json
paperworks pdf-text flowing.pdf --output flowing.txt
paperworks render flowing.pdf --output flowing-pages --max-pixels 1600
```

```sh
printf '%s' 'R = p \times q' > figure-equation.txt
paperworks equation figure-equation.txt figure-equation.png
cat > figure.json <<'JSON'
{
  "paper": "A4",
  "flow": {
    "blocks": [
      {"kind": "heading", "text": "Revenue model"},
      {"kind": "figure", "src": "figure-equation.png", "width": 240,
       "height": 100, "caption": "Figure 1. Revenue equals price times quantity."},
      {"kind": "paragraph", "text": "The figure and its caption remain together."}
    ]
  }
}
JSON
paperworks create-pdf --spec figure.json --output figure.pdf
paperworks inspect figure.pdf > figure-check.json
paperworks pdf-text figure.pdf --output figure.txt
paperworks render figure.pdf --output figure-pages --max-pixels 1600
```
